skill.name: Dataset trace filtering and preparation
skill.description: Filter and prepare cache trace datasets by excluding traces below a minimum request threshold and normalizing trace length metrics for cache eviction analysis.
skill.skill_body:
Apply the following steps to prepare trace datasets for cache algorithm evaluation:
1. Load candidate trace dataset collection.
2. Filter out any trace with fewer than 1 million requests.
3. Normalize trace length metric: express as fraction of unique objects in the trace.
4. Retain only filtered, normalized traces for downstream benchmarking.
Output the cleaned dataset collection ready for cache eviction algorithm testing.

## Objective

Prepare clean, normalized trace datasets for cache algorithm evaluation
## Applicable Signals

- Evaluating cache eviction algorithms on historical trace data
- Need to exclude sparse or incomplete traces before benchmarking
- Preparing datasets for cache performance comparison studies

## Contraindications

- Working with real-time streaming cache data
- Analyzing single-trace performance without aggregation
- Datasets already pre-filtered and normalized

## Workflow Steps

- Load trace dataset collection
- Filter: exclude traces with < 1 million requests
- Normalize: convert trace length to object fraction metric
- Validate: confirm all remaining traces meet criteria
- Output: return filtered, normalized dataset collection

## Constraints

- Minimum request threshold: 1 million requests per trace
- Trace length must be expressible as fraction of objects in trace

## Output Contract

- Filtered dataset collection with all traces meeting minimum request count (≥1 million)
- Trace length normalized to object fraction metric
- Ready for cache algorithm benchmarking
